resources.string: Enables Synqvia to capture selected text and synchronize clipboards in background when Android limits background clipboard observation.
Tap to paste, long press for options
Enable Synqvia as an Input Method to capture clipboard seamlessly and paste from history.
Synqvia is developed and maintained by Prem as an open-source project. Questions, feedback and contributions are welcome.

How to pair with my Linux PC?

string-array.name: faq_q1_steps
string-array.item: On your PC, install Synqvia and start it with `synqvia --show`.
In a terminal run `bluetoothctl`, then `power on`, `discoverable on` and `pairable on`.
On this phone open Settings > Connected devices > Pair new device, pick your PC and confirm the code on both screens.
Back in the terminal run `trust <phone MAC>`.

Find your PC\'s address with `bluetoothctl show | grep Controller`, enter it in Synqvia (tap the connection card on the Sync tab, or edit it in Settings) and tap Pair & Connect. The dot on the Sync tab turns green when connected.

string-array.name: faq_q2_steps
string-array.item: Check that the Sync tab shows Connected.
Make sure Auto Sync is on in Settings.
Android blocks background clipboard reading. For automatic capture, set Synqvia as your default keyboard (Setup tab).
Without it, use Share > Send to PC, the text-selection menu, the Quick Settings tile, or Sync Now.
Only text is synced. Images and files are not supported yet.
Make sure Synqvia is running on your PC.

string-array.name: faq_q3_steps
string-array.item: In Setup, make sure Unrestricted Battery shows Active.
In Android Settings > Apps > Synqvia > Battery, choose Unrestricted.
Some phones also need Autostart / Allow background activity turned on, and the app locked in Recents.
Turn off "Pause app activity if unused" for Synqvia.

string-array.name: faq_q4_steps
string-array.item: Bluetooth must be on for both devices.
The phone and PC must be paired, and the PC must trust the phone.
The MAC in Synqvia must match your PC\'s adapter (`bluetoothctl show | grep Controller`) and the RFCOMM channel (default 1) must match the PC.
Restart Synqvia on the PC (`synqvia --show`), then tap Sync Now.
Still failing? Remove the pairing on both devices and pair again.
Check Settings > Protocol Diagnostic Log, or run `synqvia-cli log -n 50` on the PC.

string-array.name: faq_q5_steps
string-array.item: Synqvia is open source (GPL-3.0): premtechworks/Synqvia on GitHub.
Report bugs and ideas in Issues; pull requests are welcome.
Run the tests before a PR: `./gradlew test` (Android) and `python3 -m pytest tests/ -v` (Linux).
Include your Linux distribution, Android version and logs in bug reports.
